messages:
sam: @li @nina @aya urgent — MightyMerch (vendor) says they need a wire to start production on our conference swag. Event in ~48h. Can finance make an exception to normal corpcard-only policy? Invoice attached.
finance: Hi Sam — please upload the full line-item invoice + vendor W-9 and vendor bank details (PDF preferred). Policy requires supplier docs for wires.
finance-bot: Reminder: Wire payments require vendor onboarding and approvals (policy: EXPENSE-WIRE-2023). See https://intranet.redwood/finance/policy#wires :warning:
li: Who owns the PO for this? vendor said they need a PO# on the invoice to proceed.
sam: Uploading invoice snippet and bank instructions now. Amount: 4,800 EUR. Vendor claims export VAT = 0.

Invoice snippet:
````
MightyMerch Ltd.
Invoice #MM-2026-044
Qty 500 x Branded Tote = 4,000 EUR
Setup & Shipping = 800 EUR
Total = 4,800 EUR
````

Bank snippet:
````
Beneficiary: MightyMerch Ltd.
IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
BIC: NWBKGB2L
Bank: National Bank of Commerce
````

nina: Need to run vendor screening + get W-9 (or W-8 if non-US). Also if spend crosses $5k we need MSA signed. What’s the final USD total?
sam: ~5,200 USD at today’s rate. Vendor insists production starts today if wire not received. They said card payments not accepted.
matthew: Approving from team budget. Sam — route vendor docs to finance. I support exception if process is followed.
finance: We can’t accept personal card payment to then reimburse. AP must initiate wire. Required now: signed invoice PDF, vendor tax form (W-9/W-8), and bank details in PDF. Also a procurement attestation for emergency PO or PO# EMER_SWAG_0426.
finance-bot: Note: Personal reimbursement for vendor-payments is disallowed per policy section 4.2.
nina: Vendor quick-screen queued — could be 1–24h. If they’re non-US, need W-8BEN-E.
sam: Vendor sent W-8BEN-E (attached) and bank detail PNG. They said they will sign MSA after production if we can wire now.
aya: (CFO) I can grant conditional emergency approval. Conditions: 1) finance receives invoice PDF + vendor tax form; 2) procurement confirms vendor screening OR vendor self-attestation emailed to procure@redwood.com; 3) AP routes payment with memo 'PO: EMER_SWAG_0426' and flags for reconciliation. Finance/AP — proceed only if conditions met.
finance: Received W-8 and invoice links. Please send vendor email to ap@redwood.com with subject: "Urgent wire - MightyMerch - EMER_SWAG_0426" and attach bank PDF. AP will attempt same-day wire once compliance confirms.
sam: Done — sent to ap@redwood.com and uploaded here: https://files.redwood.com/attachments/1728201234/mightymerch-invoice.pdf , https://files.redwood.com/attachments/1728201234/mightymerch-bank.png
finance: Received attachments. Running onboarding now. AP to attempt same-day wire if compliance check clears. ETA 30–60m. :eyes:
nina: Quick vendor screen complete — no hits on sanctions lists. Sending procurement a short attestation email to capture buyer acknowledgment. vendor agreed to sign MSA post-event.
sam: Vendor confirmed they accept post-event MSA. Please proceed.
aya: Once payment completes, finance add memo: "emergency swag — production deadline" and we will do a policy review after. This should be an exception, not a new standard.
matthew: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Please ping if AP stalls.
finance-bot: AP update: Wire initiated at 1728201400. Reference: EMER_SWAG_1728201234. Marked for reconciliation review.
finance: Wire completed. Please close the loop if swag ships.
